messages.subject: Error in  annotate.gr.WithGenicParts
parts:
I get an error when running 6 samfiles (ran with bismark, sorted with grep -v '^[[:space:]]*@' merged_1.sam | sort -k3,3 -k4,4n  > merged_1.sorted.sam) divided in two groups. "Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, countOverlaps(gr, prom) > 0, 1, value = 1) :
  replacement has 1 row, data has 0"

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Error in annotate.gr.WithGenicParts
parts:
We have to establish if this is because of the read.bismark or there is something downstream from that. it could be that you are getting no differentially methylated regions? or getting methylBase object with nothing in it. Check those things, then try to figure out in which step you are losing the regions/bases. it could be something simple as different chromosome naming conventions for different files, which produce 0 regions/bases at unite() step.

Best,
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Error in annotate.gr.WithGenicParts
parts:
Could you get the subset of the data that reproduces the problem  (not the whole dataset) and the code that reproduces the problem. I don't have time to go through all your files. you wrote the error is obtained at ""diffAnn <-annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff10p, gene.obj)"". Work backwards from there and send a subset of the data set and the code that reproduces the problem.

For example, If you believe the error is due to the last line send "myDiff10p" and "gene.obj", and the annotation bed file. You can save R objects using saveRDS(). Those 3 files can't be 5GB.

Best,
Altuna
